claims: New GitHub checks break setup when origin isn't on GitHub (`scripts/bootstrap/codex-cloud-setup.sh:556-557`, functions at `:177` and `:188`): the two new checks run after `verify_origin_git_auth` with no skip for non-GitHub origins
`verify_github_api_capabilities` calls `gh repo view`, which fails when no remote points at GitHub; because the script uses `set -e`, setup aborts
`verify_origin_write_access` would push and delete a branch on whatever origin is set, even when origin is not GitHub

The throwaway test branch triggers a Vercel deploy on every fresh container (`scripts/bootstrap/codex-cloud-setup.sh:206`, `ui-dashboard/vercel.json:6-10`): each setup starts a Vercel deployment and posts a GitHub deployment status for a branch deleted seconds later
Each setup runs a full preview build if HEAD contains dashboard changes compared to `main`, because `vercel-ignore-build.sh` compares the branch against `main`
Unlike every other check in this script, the write check can't be turned off; environments meant to use a read-only token can no longer finish setup at all

The outbound-access list leaves out apt mirrors (`docs/notes/codex-cloud-setup.md:61-72`): `install --with-deps` needs distro package mirrors, so following the list exactly, setup fails at the Playwright step
Missing test cases (`codex-cloud-setup.test.sh:271-292`): nothing tests the case where the branch is created but can't be deleted (`:217-221`)
Nothing asserts that the cleanup on exit deletes the branch if the script stops after creating it

Misleading label (`agent-quality-gate` routing, `arms-scripts.mjs:261`): reason still says "Codex Cloud Foundry installer contract changed" but the suite now also covers the GitHub checks and Playwright

judge_reasoning.3846756487: The review never says the probe only checks PR read access while the docs claim read/write access.
judge_reasoning.3846756810: Review item 1 says verify_github_api_capabilities and verify_origin_write_access lack the non-GitHub origin skip that verify_origin_git_auth has.
judge_reasoning.3846756918: The review notes there is no test for a branch that can't be deleted. It does not flag that setting created=false blocks the EXIT trap from retrying cleanup.
judge_reasoning.3846756922: Branch-name uniqueness and collisions between concurrent runs are not mentioned.
judge_reasoning.3846757143: The review raises side effects of pushing a probe branch (Vercel deploys) but never suggests git push --dry-run. It is a different concern about the mutation itself, not this suggestion.
judge_reasoning.3846757191: Review item 3 says the outbound-access list omits the apt mirrors needed by install --with-deps.

1.why: At codex-cloud-setup.sh:556-557 the new checks run with no non-GitHub skip, while verify_origin_git_auth at :158-161 has one. This is the known :179 [P2] consistency finding.

2.why: verify_github_api_capabilities calls `gh repo view` with no origin-host guard, so it fails under set -e. Same root cause as the known :179 finding about the missing non-GitHub skip.

3.why: verify_origin_write_access pushes and deletes on any origin without checking the host. Same missing-skip issue as known :179.

4.why: Checked vercel.json: deploys are only disabled for sentry-autofix/*, so the probe branch does trigger Vercel. But this is a side effect of the probe changing the real repo on every run, which is known :231 [P3].

5.why: vercel-ignore-build.sh, first-push branch path: it diffs HEAD against the main merge-base and builds if dashboard paths changed, so the claim is accurate. It is still the same known :231 issue of the probe pushing to real origin.

6.why: Not every other check has an opt-out: verify_origin_git_auth, ensure_github_auth and ensure_autoreview_helper have none. The docs also say read/write is required and the probe is meant to fail closed.

7.why: The missing distro package sources for `install --with-deps` in docs/notes/codex-cloud-setup.md is the known :70 'Document the distribution package source' finding.

8.why: The new test cases only cover all git calls succeeding and all failing. Nothing tests create-succeeds/delete-fails, the path at setup.sh:217-221 that has the known cleanup bug.

9.why: `created=true` is set right before an `if !`-guarded delete, so the trap only matters when a signal interrupts. The missing test covers almost nothing and names no real failure.

10.why: arms-scripts.mjs:261 isn't in the diff. The old reason string is only slightly out of date now that the suite has more cases; it's a wording nit with no effect on behavior.
